title: Shenzhen, Part 1: The County by the Sea
description:
Thomas and Clara drift back through sixteen centuries on the coast that became Shenzhen: Nantou and the salt fields, the walled towns of 1394, Xin'an county, the Great Clearance, Hakka and Cantonese villages, the Opium Wars and the new Hong Kong border, and the little railway market town called Shenzhen. Part 1 of 3.

Chapters: 1. Settling in; 2. The edge of the delta; 3. Nantou, the old seat; 4. Walls against the pirates; 5. Xin'an, a new county; 6. The great clearance; 7. Hakka and Cantonese villages; 8. Ships on the horizon; 9. A railway and a market town; 10. Not just a fishing village; 11. Goodnight.

title: Babylon: City of the Gate of the Gods
description: Henry and Clara drift through Babylon on the Euphrates: clay tablets and cuneiform, Hammurabi's laws, Nebuchadnezzar's city, the blue Ishtar Gate, the ziggurat and the star-watchers, a quiet day on the rooftops, the mystery of the Hanging Gardens, Cyrus and Alexander, and the city that faded into legend. Ancient Cities, 1 of 4.

title: Petra: The Rose-Red City of the Desert
description: Henry and Clara walk the Siq into Petra: the Nabataeans and the incense caravans, the Treasury and its legend, a city carved in stone, water saved in the desert, fine painted pottery, the Monastery at sunset, Rome and the earthquakes, and Burckhardt's quiet rediscovery. Ancient Cities, 3 of 4.

title: Teotihuacan: The Place Where the Gods Were Born
description: Henry and Clara walk the Avenue of the Dead in the high valley of Mexico: a city whose own name is lost, the Pyramids of the Sun and Moon, the Feathered Serpent and its glittering hidden tunnel, apartment compounds and painted walls, a quiet morning at the grinding stone, links to the Maya, the great fire, and Aztec pilgrims among the ruins. Ancient Cities, 4 of 4.

title: Athens: City of Athena and the Olive
description: Henry and Clara climb the Acropolis: Athena's olive tree, the birth of democracy, the Persian wars, Pericles and the Parthenon, the festival of Athena, the harbour and the long walls, theatre and Socrates, war and plague, and the Parthenon's many lives. Ancient Cities, 2 of 4.

title: Shenzhen, Part 2: A River, a Fence, an Experiment
description: Henry and Clara follow Shenzhen from 1949 to 1992: a quiet border town on the railway, two very different sides of a river, Yuan Geng's circle on the map at Shekou, the 1980 Special Economic Zone, 'Shenzhen speed', Deng's 1984 visit, the second-line fence, villages that grew upward, first land auctions and young companies, and the 1992 Southern Tour. Part 2 of 3.

title: Shenzhen, Part 3: The City of Arrivals
description: Henry and Clara follow Shenzhen from 1992 to today: millions of young arrivals and factory dormitories, 'once you come, you are a Shenzhener', the 1997 Hong Kong handover, the stalls of Huaqiangbei, Huawei, BYD, Tencent and DJI, some harder chapters, Futian's towers and Lotus Hill, electric buses and the bay, the painters of Dafen, the end of the second line, and Shekou and old Nantou today. Part 3 of 3.
